question: The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill was introduced in the Lok Sabha by which ministry on 26 July 2023?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__

• The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill was introduced in the Lok Sabha by the **Ministry of Home Affairs** on 26 July 2023.
